body:
I had taken Ambien before and enjoyed the dreamy feelings, but had never taken it in higher doses until this night. A friend told me that in higher doses some of the sleepiness goes away and the high is amazing.
My friend 'James' and I each took 4 around 9PM. James is into cocaine and alcohol, I am into mainly weed and occasionally other things. Within 30 minutes I could feel the effects. The light from the TV was bothering me so I turned it off and turned on some dim lamps. I looked at the walls and realized they were wiggling, like they were made of water and were constantly rippling. I told James this and he said he was having a similar hallucination. As far as I knew James was gay, but he started sweet-talking me and I was verrry into it. We talked for what seemed like a long time, and everything we said seemed like an epiphany (like when smoking weed and talking to a close friend). I laid next to him on the couch and he kissed me, so I kissed him back, and then everything kind of dissolved. When I woke up about 15 minutes later, I realized that I had passed out major because my nose was smashed into James' face and it kind of hurt. James was talking in his sleep like crazy, so I laughed at him doing that for a while until my laughing woke him up. By this time we had been tripping for about  2 hours and things seemed to be winding down. We made it to my bed and fell asleep and slept really gooood.
I would definitely take Ambien again, maybe in higher doses next time :)
